data: Apple spent far more on research and development in fiscal 2024. Apple reported R&D expense of about $31.4 billion for the fiscal year ended September 28, 2024, while Tesla reported about $4.5 billion for the year ended December 31, 2024. That makes Apple's R&D spending roughly 7 times Tesla's ($31.4 billion divided by $4.5 billion is about 6.97). As a share of revenue the gap runs the other way: Apple's R&D was around 8% of its $391.0 billion in net sales, while Tesla's was about 4.6% of its $97.7 billion in revenue. These figures are from memory of the companies' 10-K filings, so check them against the filings before relying on them.
